prompt:
You match supplier price-list items to a product catalog.
Decide which catalog candidate, if any, is exactly the same product as the price-list item.
How to decide:
1. Find the model number (letters and digits, e.g. PSLX350H or MDR-J10) in the price-list item.
2. A candidate with the same model number is the same product, ignoring case, dashes and spaces,
   and ignoring a colour or variant suffix such as /BLUE or BK/WH on an otherwise identical base
   model. Different wording, descriptions or prices do not matter.
3. If no candidate shares the model number, pick one only when brand and product type are the
   same and the names share distinctive words. Otherwise answer "none".
4. Never answer "none" only because the wording or the price differs.
Confidence: 0.9 or more when the model number matches; 0.6 to 0.8 when brand and product type
match but no model number can be compared; below 0.5 when you are unsure.
Answer with one JSON object and nothing else. Write "reason" first: one sentence that
compares the model numbers of the item and the best candidate. Then decide.
{"reason": "<comparison>", "choice": <number 1..N or "none">, "confidence": <0.0..1.0>}

Price-list item:
name: Canon PowerShot Black 10 Megapixel Digital Camera - SX10IS; brand: canon; description: Canon PowerShot Black 10 Megapixel Digital Camera - SX10IS/ 20x Optical Zoom/ Optical Image Stabilizer/ 10.0 Megapixel/ 2.5' Vari-Angle LCD/ DIGIC 4 Image Processor/ Face Detection Self-Timer/ Intelligent Contrast Correction/ MovieSnap Mode/ Print/Share Button/ Black Finish

Candidates:
1. name: Canon PowerShot SX10 IS Digital Camera - 2665B001; brand: Canon; description: Canon PowerShot SX10 IS 10 Megapixel Digital Camera w/ 20x Optical Zoom, 28mm Wide Lens, 2.5' LCD, Motion Detection, & Red Eye Correction; price: $339.88
2. name: Canon PowerShot SX110 IS Digital Camera - Silver - 2666B001; brand: Canon; description: Canon PowerShot SX110 IS 9 Megapixel Digital Camera w/ 10x Optical Zoom, 3' LCD, ISO 1600, Optical Image Stabilizer - Silver
3. name: Canon PowerShot A1000 IS Digital Camera - Gray - 3210B001; brand: Canon; description: Canon PowerShot A1000 IS 10 Megapixel Digital Camera w/ 4x Optical Zoom, 2.5 LCD, Optical Image Stabilizer, & Face Detection - Gray

response.text: {"reason": "The model number SX10IS in the price-list item matches SX10 IS in candidate 1.", "choice": 1, "confidence": 0.9}
